Grounding obligation description: Identify the workspace reached via: a channel containing a member who authored the specific GPU-memory-incident root-cause diagnosis message, where that message received a tada/🎉 reaction from a channel member. No workspace satisfies this full chain because the diagnosis message carries no reaction and the only stored reaction in the system is a different emoji on an unrelated message.
Shared scope: workspace(s) reachable through core-infra-style channels via a member's authored, reacted-to root-cause message
